findings.claim: MsgPack017 is incorrectly classified as AOT-only and suppressed for types using runtime serialization. Ledger entry [L6] defines it as warning that an init property initializer is replaced by the type's default during deserialization; that behavior remains relevant when the dynamic resolver is used, so this change loses an applicable analyzer warning.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an analyzer test for [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] with a keyed init property having an initializer, and mark the initializer/property with the expected MsgPack017 diagnostic. The current source-generation-only test expects no diagnostic, so the new expectation should fail against this change.
